heading.en: The hidden half of a plant

hook.en: A banyan tree in your village may have hundreds of pillar-like roots hanging from its branches. Not every root grows down from the seed.
hook.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಆಲದ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳಿಂದ ನೂರಾರು ಕಂಬದಂತಹ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬೇರುಗಳೂ ಬೀಜದಿಂದಲೇ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Distinguish tap, fibrous and adventitious roots
Name the regions of a root

narration.en: A banyan tree in your village may have hundreds of pillar-like roots hanging from its branches. Not every root grows down from the seed.
narration.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಆಲದ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳಿಂದ ನೂರಾರು ಕಂಬದಂತಹ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬೇರುಗಳೂ ಬೀಜದಿಂದಲೇ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: In most dicots the radicle grows into a primary root with lateral roots: the tap root system, as in mustard. In monocots the primary root is short-lived and is replaced by many roots from the base of the stem: the fibrous root system, as in wheat. Roots arising from parts other than the radicle are adventitious, as in grass, Monstera and the banyan tree. Roots absorb water and minerals, anchor the plant, store food and make plant growth regulators.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಯಿಬೇರು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ); ಏಕದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಂತುಬೇರು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (ಗೋಧಿ). ಭ್ರೂಣಮೂಲವಲ್ಲದ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಅಪಸ್ಥಾನಿಕ ಬೇರುಗಳು (ಆಲ, ಮಾನ್‌ಸ್ಟೆರಾ).

say.en: A dicot like mustard has one main tap root with lateral branches.
A monocot like wheat has many similar roots from the base of the stem: fibrous roots.
Now the regions of a root tip, from the bottom up.
The region of maturation bears root hairs that absorb water and minerals.
Roots are modified for storage, support and breathing.
In mangroves the roots grow upwards out of the mud to get oxygen.

narration.en: Some roots are changed to store food, hold up the plant or even breathe. Sort them.

prompt.en: Sort each modified root by the job it does.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ರೂಪಾಂತರಿತ ಬೇರನ್ನು ಅದರ ಕೆಲಸದಂತೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Prop roots of the banyan tree

explanation.en: Swollen tap roots or adventitious roots store food. Prop roots hang from branches and stilt roots grow from lower nodes to hold the plant up. In marshy, oxygen-poor soil, Rhizophora sends roots up into the air to get oxygen.

body.en: The root tip is covered by a thimble-like root cap that protects it. Behind it is the region of meristematic activity with small, dividing cells, then the region of elongation where cells grow longer, and then the region of maturation, whose epidermal cells form fine root hairs that absorb water and minerals.
body.kn: ಬೇರಿನ ತುದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರುಟೊಪ್ಪಿ, ನಂತರ ವಿಭಜನಾ ವಲಯ, ಉದ್ದವಾಗುವ ವಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪಕ್ವವಾಗುವ ವಲಯ. ಪಕ್ವ ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರುರೋಮಗಳು ನೀರು ಹೀರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Tap roots of carrot and turnip and adventitious roots of sweet potato swell to store food. Banyan has hanging prop roots that support its large branches, and maize and sugarcane have stilt roots from the lower nodes. In swampy mangroves like Rhizophora, roots grow upwards above the ground as pneumatophores to get oxygen for respiration.
body.kn: ಕ್ಯಾರೆಟ್, ಟರ್ನಿಪ್‌ನ ತಾಯಿಬೇರು ಮತ್ತು ಗೆಣಸಿನ ಅಪಸ್ಥಾನಿಕ ಬೇರು ಆಹಾರ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಧಾರ ಬೇರು, ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಬ ಬೇರು, ರೈಜೋಫೊರಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಸಿರಾಟದ ಬೇರು (ನ್ಯೂಮ್ಯಾಟೋಫೋರ್).

problem.en: Classify these as tap-root or adventitious-root modifications and give the function: carrot, sweet potato, banyan hanging roots, maize roots from lower nodes.

steps.en: Carrot: tap root, swollen for food storage.
Sweet potato: adventitious root, swollen for food storage.
Banyan hanging roots: adventitious prop roots for support. Maize roots from lower nodes: adventitious stilt roots for support.

answer.en: Carrot – tap (storage); sweet potato, banyan, maize – adventitious (storage, support, support)
